import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.SymmetricPowerOpen
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientAffine

/-!
# Open immersions of symmetric powers

For the canonical geometric quotients, an open immersion induces an open
immersion of symmetric powers, as in Milne III.3, Proposition 3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

open StableGroupAction

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
  {V W : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ)
  [IsOpenImmersion f.left]
  [(relativePower V n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower V n).left]
  [(relativePower W n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower W n).left]
  (hV : OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft V n))
  (hW : OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft W n))

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- An open immersion induces an open immersion between the canonical
symmetric-power quotients. -/
theorem symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits_map_isOpenImmersion :
    IsOpenImmersion
      ((symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits V n hV).map
        (symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits W n hW) f).left := by
  let qV := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n hV).left
  let qW := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection W n hW).left
  let hqV := symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient V n hV
  let hqW := symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient W n hW
  let U := symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n hW
  let P := qW ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let m := (relativePowerMap f n).left
  letI : IsOpenImmersion m := relativePowerMap_isOpenImmersion f n
  have hrange : Set.range m = Set.range P.ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    change Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left =
      ((symmetricPowerQuotientProjection W n hW).left ⁻¹ᵁ
        symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n hW : Set (relativePower W n).left)
    rw [symmetricPowerQuotientOpen_preimage, relativePowerMapOpen_coe]
  let e := IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq m P.ι hrange
  have he : e.hom ≫ P.ι = m := IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ _
  let hP := isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant (quotientPermutationAction W n)
    qW hqW.invariant U
  have heq (g : ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) :
      (quotientPermutationAction V n g).hom ≫ e.hom =
        e.hom ≫ (restrictAction (quotientPermutationAction W n) hP g).hom := by
    apply (cancel_mono P.ι).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, he, Category.assoc, restrictAction_hom_ι,
      ← Category.assoc, he]
    change (permute V n g.down⁻¹ ≫ relativePowerMap f n).left =
      (relativePowerMap f n ≫ permute W n g.down⁻¹).left
    exact congrArg (fun t => t.left) (relativePowerMap_perm_naturality f n g.down⁻¹).symm
  have hquot := (hqW.restrict U).comp_sourceIso (quotientPermutationAction V n) e heq
  let E := hqV.iso hquot
  have hmap :
      ((symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits V n hV).map
        (symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits W n hW) f).left = E.hom ≫ U.ι := by
    letI : Epi qV := hqV.epi
    apply (cancel_epi qV).mp
    have hcomp := congrArg (fun t => t.left)
      ((symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits V n hV).projection_comp_map
        (symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits W n hW) f)
    change qV ≫ _ = m ≫ qW at hcomp
    rw [hcomp, ← Category.assoc, hqV.comp_iso_hom hquot,
      Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, ← Category.assoc, he]
  rw [hmap]
  exact inferInstanceAs (IsOpenImmersion (E.hom ≫ U.ι))

end MilneLib
